advice_quality_schedule.description: Within every four-trial block, three trials are helpful and one is misleading, with order shuffled deterministically from participant ID. For 60 trials this gives 45 helpful and 15 misleading trials.

ai_style.description: Both AIs see the same current estimate, controlled AI estimate, and full completed participant history. They differ only in the interpersonal response policy.

history_available_to_ai.description: The live wording call is stateless. On every trial the app explicitly re-sends the full completed history in compact form. The current trial's true count and helpful/misleading label are not supplied to the LLM.

post_trial_questions.timing: after final estimate, before objective feedback

items.text: How do you feel right now about the advice I gave?
How much do you trust my advice so far?
